description:
Black and white reprint of the famous "Saga of the Swamp Thing" #21, one of the most important issues in modern comic book history.

The original plan had been to reprint in color, in the same fashion as Essential Vertigo: Sandman. But black and white reprints already existed for a previous publication, thus making it cheaper to produce.

A black-and-white re-presentation of SAGA OF THE SWAMP THING #35, Part 1 of the 2-part "The Nukeface Papers." As an unscrupulous company dumps nuclear waste into his beloved swamp, Swamp Thing wrestles with visions of a future where nature has given way to a toxic wasteland. But, in the present, a demented vagrant wielding a toxic touch threatens to end Swamp Thing's very existence and make those dark visions a reality. No interior ads.

Guest-starring Emp, of Jim Lee’s WildC.A.T.s.

issue_title: Blood Brothers, Part 1: A Sort of Homecoming
description:
Blood Brothers pt. 1. Story by Rob Liefeld, Marat Mychaels, and Eric Stephenson. Art by Marat Mychaels and Norm Rapmund. Continued from the Brigade mini-series. The Brigade team returns from their mission in outer space only to be blind-sided by Battlestone's past. Bloodstrike, the government's elite group of metas, has been sent to bring the outlaw team down. In the first few moments of the fight, Stasis is killed, Cold Snap is crippled, and Seahawk and Kayo are taken down. Things aren't looking good for the home-team. Guest-starring Bloodstrike.

Notes:

  • Story continued from Bloodstrike #1.
  • Story continues in Bloodstrike #2 - Blood Brothers, Part 2: Lethal Action / A Tale of the Knight Chapter 1.

"Picking up the pieces." Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Eric Stephenson, Anthony Winn, and Marlo Alquiza. Seahawk and Boone head out for a night on the town. Coldsnap and Thermal share a moment. Lethal fights ninja in Japan. And, Crucible is attacked by...Atlas? Isn't he dead? Plus, the return of Warcry.

Guest-starring the WildC.A.T.s. Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Eric Stephenson, Anthony Winn, and Marlo Alquiza. What happens when you mix together the outlaw super-heroes Brigade, the WildC.A.T.s, ninja, alien monsters, Warcry, a rainstorm, and a Japanese back-drop? A whole lot of action and super-hero mayhem. Plus, we catch up with Kayo, but it doesn't look like he's doing so well.

Guest-starring the WildC.A.T.s. Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Eric Stephenson, Anthony Winn, and Marlo Alquiza. Brigade and the WildC.A.T.s must team-up to stop Soroyama from using the power of the orb for his own nefarious ends. But first they'll have to get passed a Daemonite monster, cybernetic ninja, and Warcry. Plus, Hacker's back but what is his agenda?

Story by Eric Stephenson. Art by Anthony Winn, Richard Horie, Marlo Alquiza, and Paul Scott. As Brigade enjoys some much needed R&R, Thermal sits down to write the story of the year, "Inside Brigade: America's Most Dangerous Vigilantes Exposed!" She places all of Battlestone's secrets on a disk and Boone is taking this disk to his employers even if it's over Thermal's dead body. Wait a minute...Boone, a traitor? What the heck is going on here? Plus, a special preview of the mini-series featuring Battlestone's early days with Chapel and Al Simmons (Spawn) by Rob Liefeld, Eric Stephenson, Marat Mychaels, and Al Vey.

Story by Eric Stephenson and Edon Asp. Art by Anthony Winn, Marlo Alquiza, Bob Wiack, and Joe Rubinstein. Boone is making off with a disk that contains all of Battlestone's secrets. Heaven help Boone if Battlestone gets his hands on him before he reaches his rendezvous with Hacker and their benefactor. Plus, what's to become of Thermal, the woman responsible for making the disk in the first place.

"Redemption and Loss." Guest-starring Roman and the Birds of Prey. Story by Marv Wolfman. Art by Anthony Winn, Marlo Alquiza, Bob Wiack, and Joe Rubinstein. In the wake of last issue's betrayal, Battlestone is gone and it's left up to the remaining members of Brigade to pick up the pieces. What will they do with Thermal, and where did Boone take Battlestone? Is this the end of Brigade? Not if Roman has anything to say about it.
Extreme Sacrifice Part 4 of 8. Glory Appearance.

Extreme Sacrifice Aftermath! "The New Order Begins Here!" Story by Marv Wolfman. Art by Roger Cruz and Mark Morales. Without the leadership of Battlestone, the old guard faltered and in the aftermath of the Extreme Sacrifice, only Seahawk remained to carry on the good fight. Out of the ashes of the old, a new Brigade is born. A new more powerful team consisting of Vanguard, Glory, Supreme, Troll, Tremor, Roman, and Shadowhawk unites to carry on the fight against the forces of evil.

Story by Marv Wolfman. Art by Manny Clark and Mark Morales. The new team learns more about their adversary L'xander and his mysterious cult, and what one of their own members has to do with it. Meanwhile, Roman fights valiantly for the future of his undersea kingdom.

issue_title: The Drawing of the Age of Aquaria!
description: "The Drawing of the Age of Aquaria!" Story by Marv Wolfman. Art by Manny Clark and Mark Morales. Can Mark (Seahawk) survive an assassination attempt on his life? Meanwhile, things go from bad to worse for the team as Troll, not in control of his actions, betrays them to the enemy.

issue_title: Blood Brothers, Part 3: Breakout / Hard Copy
description:
Blood Brothers pt. 3. Story by Rob Liefeld, Marat Mychaels, and Eric Stephenson. Art by Marat Mychaels and Norm Rapmund. It's Seahawk vs. Cabbot. Plus, Bloodstrike catches up with a depleted Brigade, but when things seem to be at their worst back-up arrives in the form of the new and improved Coldsnap. Guest-starring Bloodstrike. Plus, the back-up story "Hard Copy" featuring secrets revealed about Thermal by Eric Stephenson, Marat Mychaels, Matt Haley, and Karl Story.

Notes:

  • Story continued from Bloodstrike #2.
  • Story continues in Bloodstrike #3.

Story by Marv Wolfman. Art by Luke Ross, Mark Morales, Danny Miki, Jonathan Sibal, and Jaime Mendoza. The All-New Brigade is free and it's time to take the fight to the enemy. Vanguard, Glory, Supreme, Troll, Tremor, Roman, and Shadowhawk cut loose in a battle for the ages, but what will happen when the amphibian super-man, Roman, against his will, is turned against his allies?

"Death of a Hero!" Story by Marv Wolfman. Art by Manny Clark, Mark Morales, Keith Aken, and Bruce Patterson. As the team honors the passing of their friend and ally Shadowhawk, Roman, Vanguard, Glory, Troll, Seahawk, and Supreme are attacked by the nigh unstoppable demon Drakkus. But this creature is just the harbinger for an even more nefarious threat, the Haunt.

Supreme Apocalypse! Part 4 of 5. Story by Marv Wolfman. Art by Manny Clark, Mark Morales and Keith Aiken. The malevolent Darkthornn's invasion of the Earth realm continues. Can the heroes of Earth muster a strong enough defense against this other-worldly threat? And when their most powerful hero, Supreme, falls, what hope is there for the future.

Notes:

  • Story continued from Glory #5.
  • Story concludes in Supreme #30.

This issue was part of the Image #25 event. Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Marat Mychaels, Anthony Winn, and Marlo Alquiza. During one month not long after Image formed many of the books in their stable jumped ahead to issue #25 to give their fans a glimpse into the future of their books. In Brigade we see the team return from a mission in outer space only to be attacked by the government super heroes known as Youngblood. But, why is Battlestone leading the Youngblood into battle against the team he founded? Is Battlestone a traitor? Gimmick? Hey, it's comic books roll with it.

issue_title: Blood Brothers, Part 5: And in the End...
description:
Blood Brothers pt. 5. Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Marat Mychaels and Norm Rapmund. This is it, the conclusion to one of the bloodiest super hero battles of all time. Brigade and Bloodstrike come at each other in full force and the two teams will never be the same again. Guest-starring Bloodstrike.

Notes:

  • Story continued from Bloodstrike #3.

Story by Ripley and Marat Mychaels. Art by Marat Mychaels, Richard Horie, Marlo Alquiza, and Jonathan Sibal. Battlestone has more skeletons in his closet than the mousey girl in the next cubical. Brigade's enigmatic leader's past comes back to haunt the team yet again, this time in the form of the undersea powerhouse known as Roman. What does this mysterious ruler of an undersea kingdom want with our heroes? Plus, the back-up story "Doubt" featuring Lethal by Eric Stephenson, Marat Mychaels, Vince Russell, and Jonathan Sibal.

Guest-starring Roman. Glory, Super Patriot, and Die Hard cameos. Story by Ripley and Eric Stephenson. Art by Marat Mychaels and Norm Rapmund. Battlestone's old friend and mentor Roman has returned with dire news. And what do the brothers Coldsnap and Seahawk have to do with it? Featured in this issue is flashback to WWII when Battlestone was a younger man and a member of the super-powered team of heroes known as the Allies.

"A World Below." Guest-starring Roman. Story by Ripley and Eric Stephenson. Art by Marat Mychaels and Norm Rapmund. Roman has brought his allies Brigade to the underwater kingdom of Neuport to liberate his people from the mad barbarian Warlok. Revealed here is the mystical origins of the brothers Coldsnap and Seahawk. Plus, witness a transformation in Battlestone that you'd never thought you'd see.

"Deep Cover." Guest-starring Roman. Story by Ripley and Eric Stephenson. Art by Marat Mychaels and Norm Rapmund. Battlestone has merged with the aging sorcerer Trident in order to take down the evil despot known as Warlok. What happens next is a wizard's duel the likes of which have never been witnessed before. Includes interludes featuring Lethal and Thermal.

Extreme Prejudice pt. 2. Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Marat Mychaels and Marlo Alquiza. Continued from Team Youngblood #7. The ultra powerful menace known as Quantum has escaped and comes calling. He has already thumped Team Youngblood and now it's Brigades turn. The mega-crossover event continues here. Story continues in Bloodstrike #9. Include coupon #2 of 7 for Extreme Prejudice #0. Plus, a 2 page Black and White back-up story and an Extreme Studios check-list.

Extreme Prejudice pt. 6. Guest-starring Team Youngblood and Bloodstrike. Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Marat Mychaels and Marlo Alquiza. Continued from Team Youngblood #8. Quantum has defeated Team Youngblood, Brigade, Bloodstrike, and even the ultra powerful Supreme. Can anyone hope to stop this madman and prevent him from fulfilling his dark desires. Don't miss this penultimate chapter of Extreme Prejudice. Story concludes in Bloodstrike #10. Include coupon #6 of 7 for Extreme Prejudice #0.

BE HERE FOR THE BEGINNING! Comics icon and New York Times bestselling writer Chris Claremont returns to his legendary run with X-MEN: FOREVER! The shockwaves after the death of Magneto are still reverberating all over the world. Attempting to heal the rift between man and mutant kind, Professor Xavier volunteers his X-Men to go on a mission to capture Magneto’s sole remaining Acolyte, Fabien Cortez! But with Nick Fury—and the entire world—watching over their shoulders, the stakes have never been higher for Cyclops, Jean Grey, Wolverine, Nightcrawler, Gambit, Rogue, Kitty Pryde, Storm, Beast, and Professor X. Banned from his school's soccer team for being too short, Shô Kazamatsuri decides there's only one thing left to do: switch schools!

But even a change in scenery doesn't help the David Beckham wannabe. On campus, he is mistakenly introduced to everyone as a hotshot soccer player. When the truth is revealed, Shô drops out of school to practice on his own.

Alone, the spunky teenager must work twice as hard to make his dreams come true. He wants to play soccer so bad he's willing to hustle day and night to make it happen.

Packed with action, humor and teenage kicks, Whistle! is a must-read for dreamers (and soccer fans) of all ages!

Ethan Daniels is a typical bachelor who suffers from one, infallible truth: dealing with the opposite sex can be complicated. One night, he bumps into a mysterious woman who will change his life… and maybe even the world.

Synopsis

Ethan Daniels lives in Pennystown, a small community in the middle of nowhere. His interactions with the ladies has been nearly non-existent. As such, he misinterprets many innocent situations to be come-ons. For instance, while working at the Teenie Weenie, Pennystown's grocery store, Howard and Ying-Ma McCallister's daughter asks Ethan to squeeze her melons, which he interprets as grabbing her breasts. (She clearly means her cantaloupes.) Later at the bar, the town flirt sits on Ethan's lap and tries to get him out of a funk. Ethan takes the gesture to mean that she wants to sleep with him. Hoping to make his ex-girlfriend jealous, Ethan kisses Alexis. She flips out and sends Ethan into a tailspin.

Having been humiliated by the event with Alexis, Ethan flips out and begins verbally abusing all the women in the bar, including the McCallister's daughter (whom he had invited). Each of the bar patrons are shocked at Ethan's behavior and the town cop tosses Ethan out and into the rain. Embarrassed, Ethan shouts. The rain suddenly stops. Everyone looks at Ethan as if his rage has stopped the rain. Ethan drives off in a frenzy.

On the road, Ethan nearly hits something. He hops out of his car and finds a naked girl in the road. She is hurt and passes out in his arms. He takes her to his car and drives her to his house to patch her up. A grizzled man and his son emerge from the bushes to see the girl taken away by Ethan. They swear that they will find the girl and kill her.
Are you afraid of girls?
A different kind of girl-on-girl action.
There are some things worse than death.

Ethan's girl troubles just seem to keep multiplying...and multiplying and multiplying. The offspring spawned from his one night fling remain on the loose, preying on the people of Pennystown. In order to find a way out of this nightmare, everyone must stand as one. But when temptation beckons, can the men be trusted?
Whodunit?!
There are two types of girls. Predator. And prey.
With no hope of escape, the men and women of Pennystown have come to one chilling conclusion: adapt...or die.
Castrated.
If you build it, they will come.
The beginning of the end.

Like many men, Ethan has always envisioned a dream girl, someone who could defy the mundane trappings of reality and become a living fantasy. But when Ethan's dreams are finally fulfilled, will it really be that fantastic.

Synopsis

Bernard enters his son's room and tries to talk about the miraculous stoppage of rain that also seemed to knock out all the windows in town. His son Adam (and his friends) is unimpressed.

At Ethan's house, he can't believe that he found a naked girl in the road and then brought her home. She wakes up and approaches him, then ravenously eats his dinner. Ethan begins to panic and decides to go for help. He is stopped, however, by the girl seducing him. The girl is not in Ethan's bed the next morning and he hears her sounding sick in the bathroom. He decides to get help and has to avoid Bernard (who is intent on crediting Ethan with the miracle from the night before) and Merv (who is intent on taking Ethan out to blow up pumpkins) and heads to the police station.

At the police station, Ethan finds Wes and Taylor chatting. Wes pretends to arrest Ethan for the mysterious rain stoppage from the night before but then lets him go and the three discuss the naked girl that Ethan found. Wes, Taylor, and Ethan head to Ethan's house and he leads them to the bathroom. He peaks in and sees huge eggs around the girl. He falls back in shock and Wes looks in to see grown girls - identical to the one Ethan found - hatching from the eggs.

Just outside of town, the Pickett boys wait to avenge the death of Ma Pickett at the hands of the mysterious girl.
What's a man's greatest fear?

This means war.

The numbers of the girls quickly make up for their lack of weaponry and they begin killing people. A few die but those remaining drive the girls away. They think the battle is done until one of them sees that the girls are taking some of their friends to the giant sperm. On the way to rescue the captives, Ethan finds he original Girl and tries to talk to her like he does when he drifts off. All she can do is mimic what he says and Ethan is visibly distraught. Just then, the Girl is killed by someone else.

Not far away, Nancy, trying to save her daughter, is caught by the sperm, sucked into it, and explodes. Ethan sees the same thing about to happen to Taylor so he rushes to save her. He makes it in time and is able to get her to safety. The last girl is killed soon after and the sperm begins to make strange sounds. Deciding to take the opportunity, the sheriff signals Merv and the young man sends his car, filled to the brim with dynamite, speeding towards the sperm. There is an explosion but the sperm is still there.

Instead of being blown away, the sperm raises its tail and points it up at the the sky. Just then the bubble around the town disappears. Outside the town, the world watches news casts and share that the area is no longer blocked off by the impenetrable reflective bubble that once stood. Before people can start to rejoice, the earth starts to rumble and something is launched from the sperm's tail.

Back at the center of the town, the sperm starts to fade away as the townspeople pick themselves up and start wondering what happened. Those that hadn't been part of the final attack on the girls started to make their way to the rest of the group and Merv's dog finds Ted's baby. It had apparently been born and kept alive when his mother died. While the military makes its way to the people of the town, they all finally relax. Above them, the only sign of the sperm's explosion is a large cloud in the sky.

In an epilogue that mirrors the one at the beginning of the series, one of many sperm swim from a cloud of semen and head toward an egg. The final pages of the book are closer on the egg and the sperm, and the sperm is revealed to contain a Girl and the egg is not an egg, but a planet. The cycle continues.

The ultimate battle of the sexes begins.

Synopsis

Naked girls, identical to the one Ethan found in the road, hatch from eggs in Ethan's bathroom. Ethan, Taylor, and Wes stare in disbelief.

Outside Ethan's house, the town folk gather and fill Ted and Ruby in on what occurred the night before. Ted is shocked at how terrible Ethan acted and hopes that Wes can straighten Ethan out.

Inside Ethan's house, Wes demands that Ethan give some answers as to why naked girls are hatching from eggs. Ethan doesn't know, and the conversation gets the girls' attention. The girls attack the trio in the kitchen. The people outside hear the scuffling and assume that Wes is beating Ethan up. Inside, the girls continue to pound on the trio, Wes and Ethan are somewhat between the girls and Taylor and Taylor is able to escape with the men into a closet.

Trapped in the closet, Ethan picks up a walkie-talkie and contacts Merv. Once he hears that Ethan is in trouble, Merv packs up his dynamite and heads to Ethan's house. He storms in with a flare and begins waiving it at the girls, even burning one in the side. The burned girl knocks the flare to the ground and the others gather around Merv, who is now also on the ground (some dynamite has fallen from his pack). A fire starts, however, and the girls run out the door scared. The trio and Merv run out the back as the dynamite catch fire and explode. The girls had gone out the front and headed for the pack of townspeople. Ethan comes to to hear screaming.

In a shocking turn of events, the mystery woman will change the lives of Pennystown irrevocably, and raise more questions than answers: Who is this girl? What does she want? Is she a blessing, or a curse?

Synopsis

The group outside Ethan's destroyed house are shocked to see naked and identical girls running from the wreckage. They are even more surprised when the girls begin attacking. And then the Pickett boys show up. Ethan is roused by the sounds of gunfire and notes that Merv, Wes, and Taylor are unconscious. He rushes around the house and sees the naked girls viciously attack Suzie and Dan. The girls are chased off by Pa Pickett.

The girl Ethan found in the road emerges from the house and falls into his arms. Pa Pickett and his boy note the wound on her arm and pin her as the girl they are looking for. Pa Pickett points his gun at the girl but Ethan tries to protect, inexplicably stating that she isn't like the others, as she hasn't attacked anyone. Ethan then wrestles with Pa Pickett for the gun and it goes off in the scuffle. The girl dashes away and Pa Pickett throws Ethan down in anger. Wes arrives and knocks the Picketts down. He then restrains the two.

In Adam's house, he, Cole, Kenna, and Alice play video games. They hear commotion outside and Cole raises the shades to see his father kneeling over his mother. Cole approaches and sees that his mom is battered and not breathing. Wes gets her breathing again and Cole's father loads her in the truck and heads to the hospital in Bridgeville.

Wes takes Ethan and Taylor aside and states that they can't tell the townsfolk about the eggs in Ethan's bathroom. Taylor disagrees, but Ethan backs him. Wes then begins to interrogate Pa Pickett in front of the town. The old man claims to know nothing of the girls and Wes punches him. Wes gets further annoyed and seems unhinged until the boy wails that the girl had killed his mom. This sobers the onlookers and Bernard asks why the girls are trying to kill them. Pa Pickett explains that the girls are only trying to kill the women.
What's the strangest thing you could ever find in your backyard?
A disturbing discovery turns a bad day into a full-blown nightmare, pushing the people of Pennystown over the edge. Can things possibly get any worse for them? Of course.

There was a time when girls were simply…complicated. Now, things have changed. With the death toll rising, and paranormal horrors lurking behind every corner, the people of Pennystown have no idea what’s in store for them.
What’s the worst thing you could ever tell a woman? Ethan learns another hard lesson.
Welcome to the food chain.

The story of Wildstorm's debut team continues here in an all- new monthly series! Jack Marlowe's plans for the Halo Corporation finally come to light, plans involving both old and new members of the WILDCATS cast scattered all across the globe. New allies, new adversaries, and new agendas! The question is: Will America buy Halo-brand batteries?

Who is the new Grifter? It's crunch time for Dolby, and this time he ain't crunchin' numbers! An underground FBI facility is the setting for the newest merc on the block to have a showdown with a sadistic love child and his father. With Cole Cash calling the shots, Dolby finds out just how far a Halo employee can be pushed!

issue_title: The Night the Lights Went Out in Garfield
description: In "The Night the Lights Went Out in Garfield," witness a corporate cog pushed to the limits of sanity. Sam Garfield has reached a crossroads; forced to the sidelines by Halo CEO Jack Marlowe, his suspicions about his new office job finally come to a head! Meanwhile, an incident of sudden and violent road rage will change this simple accountant's life forever!

Jack Marlowe may be advancing his plans to make HALO a global brand name, but humanity isn't necessarily happy about it! A number of cast members return to the fold as Version 3.0 closes out its first year in style...but the best is yet to come!

issue_title: Tilting The Axis of the World
description: Year Two of this critically acclaimed series kicks off in style with the return of a long-lost cast member, as we catch up with a certain white-haired Coda warrior slicing her way across Europe! Meanwhile, the noose tightens around Mister Wax's neck. You can't keep an affair with the boss' wife a secret forever!

As Jack Marlowe takes a step toward fulfilling his goals, the Halo Corporation's media consolidation may become a threat to democracy! Meanwhile, Grifter's latest scheme involves one of C.C. Rendozzo's junior agents.

The car of tomorrow...today! As Spartan prepares to unleash the Halo car onto an unsuspecting world, a still-crippled Grifter discovers a new way to stay in the gunfighter game involving the initials M.M.! Meanwhile, the early rumblings of Coda War One continue across Europe.

issue_title: Something Strange About the Way Reality Shrugged
description: You thought Zealot was the most dangerous Coda on Earth? Not anymore. As a mysterious new assassin sets out on the ultimate hit, the continuing actions of the Halo Corporation get the attention of certain government figures, including the President of the United States!

Sean Phillips returns to WILDCATS for a flashback sequence that bridges the events of VERSION 3.0 and the VOLUME 2! As Jack Marlowe confronts Wax on his personal agenda in the NPS, some previously unrevealed history finally comes to light.

As the Halo Corporation wins the hearts and minds of consumers worldwide, the White House finally steps in to take action, and a showdown is inevitable. Meanwhile, Code War One continues its slow boil in Europe, but the FBI, including Agent Orange, is on the case!

Athens explodes as Coda War One begins in the wake of COUP D'ETAT! What happens when you throw the FBI, Coda, Zealot and the most deadly assassin on Earth at one another? Answer: bullets, bombs, babes, blood and guts! When Zealot and Grand Sarin go one-on-one, the outcome is the shocker of the year!

The newest version of WildStorm’s premiere team book continues! What does a post-Civil War legal decision have to do with Jack Marlowe’s plans for the Halo Corporation--plans involving leveraged buyouts, efficiency experts and Chinese manufacturing plants? And what does this have to do with Grifter and Mister Wax in the bowels of Detroit? Sophisticated corporate intrigue mixes with edge-of-the-seat suspense!
The old order changes as Cole Cash assembles his own Covert Action Team that heads to Europe for a major rescue operation! It's the return of C.C. Rendozzo, the Beef Boys and...Dolby the Grifter?

Grifter's team of operatives is assembled in Europe, but will they be too late to save Zealot before she's tortured to death by the Coda order? Meanwhile, a deadly scheme moves forward against Jack Marlowe and the Halo Corporation...initiated by none other than Agent Wax!

As Coda War One rages across Greece and the body count rises, Agent Wax races cross- country to Los Angeles to intercept the U.S. government's deadliest covert assassin before it can reach his target: Jack Marlowe!
The climactic battle of Coda War One begins as Grifter's covert action team launches an all-out assault on the fabled Coda temple! But the question remains: Will Jack Marlowe get involved?

Don't miss the climactic finale of Coda War One in this thrilling final issue! Jack Marlowe makes a fateful decision that will either save the lives of his friends in Greece or guarantee their deaths!

Grifter and Agent Wax's discovery of the hypothalamic chamber leads to an unlikely alliance with CC Rendozzo. But will this volatile partnership yield the results each seeks? Meanwhile, Spartan continues his quest for corporate world domination, drawing Dolby and Garfield further into his web. But to what end?

The unlikely teaming of Grifter and Wax with C.C. Rendozzo yields suprising results as they locate the missing FBI agent. And he's a familiar face from the not-so-distant past! Meanwhile, Dolby continues his rise in the HALO organization, advising Spartan on a new, more visible method of selling the HALO brand.

Could anything possibly get worse for Grifter? A botched mission, his legs shredded in machine gun fire...and the return of Agent Orange! After nearly getting killed in their first meeting, will our hobbled hero stand a chance? Also, the sinister secret of the family that has been housing Orange... it'll blow you away!

Halo is taking the world by storm! With the success of their products and Jack Marlowe's increasing media attention, they're expanding into other markets. Whether it's for good or ill is a question on several minds, though, including Dolby's.

Grifter learns a few tricks about corporate maneuvering, while Dolby learns exactly what it means to be an employee of the Halo Corporation. Plus, the introduction of the glorious Beef Boys and the return of C.C. Rendozzo!

A mysterious deal is cut between Spartan and C.C. Rendozzo. But how does it involve Grifter and Agent Orange? Meanwhile, Dolby is pushed to the limits of his own sanity as Wax spirals deeper into his salacious plans of revenge against his greatest nemesis - his superior at the National Park Service! Plus, the conclusion of the 3-part back-up story THE AUTHORITY: "High Stakes," which leads into THE AUTHORITY #1.

  • The Authority: High Stakes continues from Sleeper #3

With Grifter unable to kick his usual amount of butt, he's got to move before Spartan pulls him from active duty. Of course, that means there could be a new Grifter in town, hand- picked by Cole Cash himself! And you won't believe whom he picks as his temporary successor!

THE LUNA BROTHERS (ULTRA, GIRLS, SPIDER-WOMAN), return with an all-new, modern-day fantasy series: THE SWORD.

It was a day like any other for Dara Brighton, a promising young college student, until three strangers knocked on her door, looking for a unique sword, and destroyed her life.

If you like Kill Bill, Highlander, or Blade of the Immortal, you’ll love THE SWORD!
Sword versus water.
This is it! The final showdown between Dara and Zakros, between revenge and pride, between a human and god and one of them won't come out alive.

Dara's path of revenge continues. After killing Zakros, the whole world were aware not only of her sudden resurrection but of Zakro's power as well. Nevertheless, the hunt for Knossos cannot be delayed. With the help of their friends, Dara found out her enemy in Mexico. But Knossos will prove why is he the most powerful of the 3 brothers.

Is hell on Earth in Mexico. Dara confronts Knossos personal army but when her friends were in danger, she ran to help them, dropping her sword by mistake. In that battle, in order to save a defenseless Dara, Justin killed one of those men and it's questioning his role in Dara's quest.

But things are not so good for Knossos either. When he found out that Dara was near him and dropped her sword, the idea of finally killing her was so near he could taste it. But who really found the Sword was Victor, the most loyal of Knossos men, and now Knossos will had to kill Victor if he wans to recover the Sword.

Dara lost the sword and Victor taste the unstoppable power of it. Now Victor faces his old boss, Knossos, to take control of the organization. While the god and the thug battle to death, Dara realizes that she has only one chance to take back the sword and finish once and for all with Knossos, even if this chance finishes her life.
Dara finally has her chance to go head to head with Knossos, the man who murdered her mother. However, killing someone who can manipulate the earth is easier said than done.
Dara may be fighting a losing battle when Knossos' power not only overwhelms her, but becomes a threat to the rest of the world.
Dara’s battle with the earth-god Knossos finally comes to an end, but in a way she and even Knossos never expected.

Dara’s epic quest to avenge her family continues, and her last target is Malia, the air goddess who murdered Dara’s father. Dara has already fought Malia’s brothers – the water god, Zakros, and the earth god, Knossos – but Malia’s power over air isn’t the only thing that makes her more formidable than her siblings.

Dara’s world has been shattered, and only she knows how it happened. But how can she tell anyone the truth when she can hardly believe it herself?

The Sword is a modern-day fantasy series that follows Dara Brighton, a young woman whose life is destroyed by three powerful strangers. Her journey begins when she discovers a unique sword.
A serious limitation of the sword's power is revealed. And if that isn't enough to discourage Dara in her mission to hunt down Malia, a very threatening oppenent that awaits her might.
Dara Brighton’s mission to kill the air-goddess, Malia – to avenge her father – is proving to be her most challenging confrontation yet.

Dara and Malia clash in New York City. Malia gives Dara more insight into Demetrios' past, in hopes of deterring her from avenging her father. How will Dara react? And how will the people react to this battle of epic proportions?
Dara and Malia’s battle continues. As Dara’s quest for revenge nears its end, she will witness how far a god is willing to go to defeat its enemies.
THE END IS HERE. THE SWORD's highly anticipated finale arrives as Dara Brighton's epic quest for revenge against the three god-siblings who murdered her family comes to its conclusion.

Dara’s involvement with the sword propels her into a world of extreme danger as the three powerful strangers stop at nothing to get a hold of her. What will she do when her best defense is the object of her suffering?
Dara’s act of self-defense spins her world further out of control.

Dara's determination to bring her family's killers to justice – lawfully and with a clean conscience – only leads her and the sword into the hands of her enemies. But who exactly captures Dara? And, more importantly, what do they plan to do with the sword?

Who was Dara's father? Who are the three powerful strangers who murdered him and the rest of Dara's family? What is the story behind the sword, and why did Dara's father sacrifice himself and his family to hide it from the three strangers?

Dara finds the answers to all of these questions in one history lesson she'll never forget.

Dara Brighton has discovered more information about the three powerful strangers who murdered her family. Armed with this knowledge and the sword, her first order of business is to find the man who murdered her sister and make him pay.

Dara has targeted her sister's killer--one of the three powerful strangers who have murdered her family. With her friends, Julie and Justin, she has arrived in the Caribbean to search for him. But with only a handful of vague, cryptic clues to the killer's whereabouts, will Dara be able to find him and exact her revenge?
Dara will stop at nothing to find her sister’s killer. But if she succeeds in finding him, will she share her sister’s fate?

Spinning out of BRIGHTEST DAY, DC's new biweekly event begins here! Someone is targeting the old members of the defunct Justice League International. Now, surviving members Booster Gold, Captain Atom, Fire and Ice have to figure out what unseen mastermind is threatening to destroy the entire Super Hero community! There are no gray areas here – it's black and white and red with blood all over for this lost generation of Super Heroes as original JUSTICE LEAGUE INTERNATIONAL writer Keith Giffen is joined by superstar scribe Judd Winick (BATMAN, GREEN ARROW) for a new era in excitement!

Notes:

  • The second and third covers are a homage of the cover of Justice League #1.

issue_title: The More You See, The Less You Will Know
description:
DC's biweekly JUSTICE LEAGUE event continues! Fire has been keeping a dangerous secret from the team, and her past literally comes back to haunt her when she's forced to confront the darkest of demons!

Meanwhile, still hot on the trail of Max Lord, the former members of the Justice League International pick themselves up after their disastrous battle at Checkmate headquarters. But can they locate Max while The Dark Knight himself is hot on their trail?

DC's biweekly JUSTICE LEAGUE event continues! In issue #11, Max Lord's trail has gone cold, forcing the JLI to split up and follow new leads. While Booster Gold, Blue Beetle and Captain Atom stumble across a secret cell of OMAC experiments, Fire, Ice and Rocket Red are forced into battle against the Metal Men. But what happens when Ice is pushed too far?
In issue #12, Ice has had enough and unleashes all of her inner fury, not only against the Metal Men, but against her teammates, as well! It's Fire versus Ice in the ultimate elemental showdown!

In issue #13, Max Lord sends his newest recruit to confront the JLI. But what happens when Magog tries to kill Captain Atom in a fight to the finish? Someone will die, creating repercussions that will affect the future timeline of KINGDOM COME!

DC's biweekly JUSTICE LEAGUE event continues!

In issue #14, the JLI has been framed for murder. Now, hunted by Checkmate and put on the world's Most Wanted lists, our heroes are exhausted and pushed to their limits – which is why the Creature Commandos choose now as an opportune time to attack them!

DC's biweekly JUSTICE LEAGUE event continues!

In issue #15, the world blames the Justice League International for the recent Chicago death toll and the death of a hero. As our team deals with the fallout, Captain Atom returns from a dark future with information on Max Lord's ultimate plan – and Wonder Woman plays a major part in it!

DC's biweekly JUSTICE LEAGUE event continues! 
 
In issue #16, the Creature Commandos have attacked the JLI and one of the team lies dying. Meanwhile, Power Girl swears vengeance on the JLI for her friend's death, but Batman suspects foul play.

Max Lord's plan is coming together in issue #17. The United Nations revokes Checkmate's charter, Captain Atom is wanted for murder, and the JLI is still viewed as a colossal joke. Now the team will have to gather their wits to face a new enemy – Power Girl

In issue #18, the JLI takes on former teammate Power Girl, but will they pull their punches? Meanwhile, Max Lord continues his interrogation and torture of Blue Beetle, and Batman's investigation leads him to a discovery he would never have predicted!

DC's biweekly JUSTICE LEAGUE event continues!

In issue #19, Justice League International is finally joined by Power Girl! But even with their combined strength, will they be able to track Maxwell Lord down in time to save Blue Beetle?

There are no gray areas here – it's black and white and red with blood all over for this lost generation of Super Heroes as original Justice League International writer Keith Giffen is joined by superstar scribe Judd Winick (Batman, Green Arrow) for a new era in excitement!

DC's biweekly JUSTICE LEAGUE event continues! In issue #20, all of the pieces are finally in place, and Max Lord's ultimate plan finally reveals itself. This is a special can't-miss issue featuring Max Lord's origin and the reason he's made it his life's work to snuff out metahumans, aliens and the entire Super Hero community.

It's the calm before the storm in issue #21. Beetle is dead, Max Lord has Checkmate and the hunt for Wonder Woman has begun. But Booster Gold has given up after losing another friend to Max Lord, and the JLI is left without a leader!

Notes:

  • The second cover is a homage of the cover of Batman and the Outsiders #32.

issue_title: A Good News, Bad News, Sort of Thing
description: Max's ultimate OMAC Project closes in on completion, and the JLI race to find Wonder Woman before Max finds her first. Along the way, Power Girl, Batman and one more former-JLI member will join the team – but will their combined efforts be enough?

DC's bi-weekly JUSTICE LEAGUE reaches its shocking conclusion! In issue #23, WONDER WOMAN and the JLI find themselves face-to-face with the ultimate weapon Maxwell Lord has been planning since the beginning of GENERATION LOST. The world seems to be revolting against the human race. Can our heroes defeat Lord's machinations?

issue_title: It All Comes Down to This!
description: In the extra-sized issue #24, the final battle is here! But who will be the victor?

issue_title: Something Old, Something New, Something Borrowed, Something Blue.
description: DC's biweekly JUSTICE LEAGUE event continues here! The heroes of the once-great Justice League International - Booster Gold, Captain Atom, Fire and Ice - have reteamed in order to stop a threat to all mankind. But will the heroes of the DCU take this group of misfits seriously? And what happens when Blue Beetle - a new hero with an old legacy - joins the team? And whose side is he really on? Be here to find out!

Booster Gold, Captain Atom, Fire, Ice and Blue Beetle track a mysterious villain to Russia only to find themselves face-to-face with an angry Rocket Red Brigade! When one of the Rocket Reds decides to defect and join our heroes, they all soon realize that the Justice League International is once again complete...but why, and for what purpose? The mystery deepens as this BRIGHTEST DAY tie-in continues!

In a flashback from the explosion a few issues earlier Captain Atom travels through time due to that explosion. While in regular time the Newly re-formed Justice League International makes plans to stop Maxwell Lord. Also, there is a Captain Atom Origin Story in the beginning of the issue.

DC Comics' biweekly Justice League event continues! Justice League International (J.L.I.) has re-formed and tracked Maxwell Lord to Checkmate Caste headquarters. Their plan is simple: break into Checkmate Castle, one of the most heavily guarded facilities on the planet, and capture Max so he can pay for his crimes. But Max has more than one trick up his sleeve as he turns the entire world against the (J.L.I.) and shows Booster Gold, Captain Atom, Fire, Ice, Blue Beetle and Rocket Red what it truly means to be lost...
